content:
George Miller said
How to automatically delete messages from server once they are downloaded to my PC? It's an IMAP account

You can not. IMAP is synchronized to the server. Once the message is gone from the server account it is also gone from the account in Thunderbird. Many folk rely on filters to move message into the "local folders" account and they deletes the mail from the server, but it is error prone and is essentially an attempt to fight the IMAP protocol.

The POP protocol is best designed to download mail locally and delete it from the server and is my recommendation. You might want to set the POP account to delete mail from the server after 7 or 14 days sop you have the latest mail in your phone but that is something you need to decide.

SO IMAP on your phone and POP for your local storage and subsequent deletion form the mail server. The right tool for the job.
